name: Standard Arena
description: Combined arena geometry: bounds, river, bridges, towers, deployment zones, movement rules and match rules. Replaces the separate arena.json, river.json and bridge.json.

coordinate_system.origin: arena center; the center is a tile corner, not a tile center
coordinate_system.y: own back edge (-16000) to enemy back edge (+16000); own side is y < 0
coordinate_system.tile_grid: tile edges fall on whole multiples of 1000; tile centers fall on odd multiples of 500
coordinate_system.alignment_rule: an odd-width footprint (3x3) has its center on a tile center (x and y both end in 500); an even-width footprint (4x4) has its center on a tile corner (x and y both end in 000)

provenance_legend.app: read by the user from the Clash Royale app
provenance_legend.derived: computed from other fields in this file
provenance_legend.design_decision: rule chosen for the simulator; verify in-game

king.y_provenance: derived from '1 tile from the back' and a 4x4 footprint

towers.princess_y_formula: center_y = -(1000 + N*1000 + 1500), where N is the number of tiles between the river edge and the front of the princess tower. N = 7 gives -9500. Count N in the app and correct this value if it differs.

king_activation.wake_up_delay_status: unverified: the king takes a few seconds to bring out the cannon

deployment.snap_note: Placement snaps to tile centers. A troop spawns at the tile center plus its spawn offsets.
deployment.building_rule: the whole footprint (3x3, or 2x2 for Tesla-sized buildings) must sit inside the legal zone on the tile grid; there is no separate border margin

pocket_zones.trigger: destroying an enemy princess tower opens a pocket on that lane's side of the enemy half
pocket_zones.geometry_status: NEEDS MEASUREMENT: x range and how many tiles deep past the river. Count them in the app after a princess tower falls.
pocket_zones.wide_formation_rule: Royal Recruits need both princess towers destroyed before they can be deployed in a pocket, because the 15000 formation is wider than one lane half (9000). Derived from the width and consistent with community wiki.

river_jumpers.note: Targeting and attackability while jumping belong in each card's own file.

match_rules.note: Belongs in a separate rules.json once Phase 3 starts; kept here for now.
match_rules.overtime: sudden death: the first tower destroyed wins
match_rules.tiebreaker_at_overtime_end: the side whose lowest-HP tower has the lowest HP loses; equal lowest HP is a draw
match_rules.schedule_note: 2x covers the final minute of regulation and the first minute of overtime; 3x covers the last minute of overtime. 3x rate (one elixir per 2.8/3 s) is assumed from the 1x rate; confirm in-app.

elixir_model.note: Store elixir in 56ths. At 1x one elixir takes 56 ticks, so every tick adds 1 subunit; 2x adds 2; 3x adds 3. A card costing 7 elixir costs 392 subunits. This keeps 3x exact (2.8 s / 3 is not a whole number of ticks).

unverified: Princess tower center y (-9500 is a grid-aligned guess; the old -10000 was not on the tile grid).
Tile-snapped placement and spawn offsets measured from the snapped tile center.
King tower wake-up delay in ticks.
Navigation mesh and exact bridge centering while crossing.
That the bridge tiles cannot be deployed on (assumed because they overlap the river rows).
Tower footprints come from a community wiki; confirm 4x4 and 3x3 in the app.
